approval_basis: Owner-authorized successor completing the exp2 and reciprocal vocabulary widening released as v69. This approval was written by the author session at the owner's explicit instruction; no independent reviewer session inspected the change, so it does not carry the independent-review basis of approvals made under ADR 0052 by a distinct session. It exists because v69 was released before the full suite ran, which then surfaced two completeness contracts the widening had not satisfied: the Triton backend must implement every member of the arithmetic vocabulary, and the wiki must document every operation. Triton now emits tl.exp2 and an explicit 1.0 / x divide rather than an unmeasured approximation, and the wiki records that exp2 is not a rewrite of exp because a Schedule that wants it must scale its own operand by log2(e) and owns that rounding. What the author session did verify: the Corpus Gate was rebuilt from source and matched 124/124 cases over 171 bound sources for draft open-cake-ir-sm100a-v70-draft, with every expectation unchanged from v69, so adding the two Triton templates altered no existing lowering. No device measurement of either operation was taken on any target, so no performance claim is approved here. This approves the Compiler successor only; it approves no Executor release, no framework acceptance and no scientific arm comparison.
